mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.school_id, s.school_name, c.class_name, c.class_code, c.grade_id, g.grade_name, c.head_teacher_id, u.teacher_name AS head_teacher_name, us.id AS headTeacherUserId, c.enrollment_year, c.graduation_year, c.remark, c.class_count, c.create_time, c.update_time, t.id AS termId, t.term_name FROM t_educl_class c LEFT JOIN t_educl_term t ON t.id = c.term_id and t.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_school_manage s ON s.id = c.school_id LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON g.id = c.grade_id LEFT JOIN t_as_teacher u ON u.id = c.head_teacher_id LEFT JOIN t_base_user us on us.id = u.user_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_valid = 1
